name: Muse Code
desc: Meta's terminal coding agent, built on Muse Spark.
desc_zh: Meta 基于 Muse Spark 的终端编程智能体
solves: Terminal only, and macOS. Inside that limit it reads and edits across files without a browser in the loop.
solves_zh: 只在终端里用，且只支持 macOS。在这个范围内它能跨文件读写，不必再开浏览器。
best_for: A coding agent you drive from the shell, without leaving it.
best_for_zh: 想从 shell 里驱动编码 Agent，又不打算离开 shell。
notes: Marginal still — it shipped in beta; worth watching as a fourth entrant alongside Codex, Claude Code and Grok Build. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.meta.com/ai/ 2026-11-25：released 2026-08-01/day → 2026-08-05/day; source https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-code-and-muse-spark-1-2。原值 2026-08-01 是月份占位。Meta 官方发布测试版的博文日期是 2026 年 8 月 5 日
